text:
felix: Heads up  HorizonGrid invoice INV-HG-7032 blocked. PO on pdf = HG-2023-077 (legacy) but master shows HG-2026-004 as current. Also vendor updated bank details in same upload.

tanya: Can someone confirm vendor provided any mapping doc? If not, system will hold.

omar: Vendor confirms correct PO=HG-2026-004; AP mistakenly reused legacy PO when reissuing. They uploaded a signed PO amendment and bank ownership proof. Link: https://files.horizon.example/INV-HG-7032-amend.pdf

mika: Procurement is remote today. If the amendment includes tax ID and both PO numbers, we can reconcile after the fact. Bank change still requires KBA.

approvals-bot: Hold applied: reasons=[PO_MISMATCH, BANK_UPDATE]; required_actions=[attach_po_amendment, vendor_kba_doc, procurement_reconcile_or_2up_finance].

tanya: If Finance posts audit note with GL and cost center and Vendor uploaded KBA, I can request treasury manual override for next ACH run.

felix: GL=6201-model-inference; cost_center=ml-infra-prod. Audit note: "Temporary finance release requested; vendor amendment and bank proof attached; procurement to reconcile PO mapping upon return."

omar: Amendment includes EIN and both POs per procurement request. Uploaded.

tanya: Submitted manual override to Treasury: ref "HorizonGrid PO mismatch + bank update; temporary finance signoff; docs attached." ETA 24-36h. Flagged high priority due to late fee.

approvals-bot: Documents verified uploaded. Pending: treasury_manual_override or procurement_reconcile.

felix: Will monitor and update when payment clears. If Treasury rejects, escalate to Finance Lead for emergency sign-off.

omar: Vendor thanks team ":pray:"
_meta: Slack thread export: vendor invoice with legacy PO + bank update; root message and replies in chronological order
